commands.command:
set -eu
ROOT=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
TREE=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/termux-helper-consolidation-qa-20261101-v1
REF=chore/termux-dev-helper-consolidation-20261101
SHA=c8e73e3000496921310a25180e792061280b0bcd
git -C "$ROOT" fetch origin "$REF"
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$SHA"
test ! -e "$TREE"
git -C "$ROOT" worktree add --detach "$TREE" "$SHA"
cd "$TREE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git hash-object scripts/termux-dev.sh)" = d5727f5672865ab2092b56d30aaae8d8ae799866
test "$(git hash-object docs/termux-dev.md)" = ee4dda9cf07eb37c11f3d18c6726cabb31b0e072
test "$(git diff --name-only deaa562cdeaffff0b14beafa2a2bd1a128bf38fe..HEAD | sort)" = "$(printf '%s\n' docs/termux-dev.md scripts/termux-dev.sh)"
bash -n scripts/termux-dev.sh
if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck scripts/termux-dev.sh; else echo "SHELLCHECK_NOT_INSTALLED"; fi
BEFORE=$(shasum -a 256 backend/requirements.txt | awk '{print $1}')
set +e
env PREFIX=/usr HOME="$HOME" bash scripts/termux-dev.sh status > "$TREE/.dev-denied.out" 2>&1
RESULT=$?
set -e
test "$RESULT" = 2
grep -q 'Only the Termux app-private runtime is supported' "$TREE/.dev-denied.out"
rm "$TREE/.dev-denied.out"
env PREFIX=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr HOME=/data/data/com.termux/files/home bash scripts/termux-dev.sh requirements
test -s .dev/termux/requirements-native.txt
grep -Fxq 'uvicorn==0.34.0' .dev/termux/requirements-native.txt
! grep -q 'uvicorn\[standard\]' .dev/termux/requirements-native.txt
test "$(shasum -a 256 backend/requirements.txt | awk '{print $1}')" = "$BEFORE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git diff --check deaa562cdeaffff0b14beafa2a2bd1a128bf38fe..HEAD
echo ===TERMUX_ISOLATED_HELPER_QA_PASS===
git rev-parse HEAD
